race.comment: DRAW ATTENTION (3) is the one to beat after wins at the Sunny Coast and Gold Coast, the latest a soft-ground BM62 demolition job as favourite. Steps up in grade again but gets a key booking in Thompson. Can go on with the job. CASTELLO GRANDE (4) comes from Saturday company at Eagle Farm, finishing just under a length from the winner on heavy ground after a wide trip. Does his best work late, so watch for him if the early tempo is strong. WHATJEUDOIN' (2) also holds genuine appeal as a proven track-and-trip winner returning to a more suitable distance. TRUSTY BANDIT (5) failed to bring up the hat-trick last time at Eagle Farm but was almost too bad to be true. suspect he can bounce back and play a more significant role.
